basics.brief: Computer Science undergraduate in the John Hopcroft Class, Zhiyuan College, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; visiting student at Harvard Vision and Learning Lab, working with Prof. Qianqian Wang.

courses: John Hopcroft Class, Zhiyuan College (Honor Program)

highlights: Studying distribution matching and generator Jacobian geometry for efficient one-step generation.
Advisors: Yifan Yang and Chong Luo.
Designed tool-integrated reinforcement learning for multimodal reasoning; developed EnvOpt for closed-loop environment optimization.
Co-led a model-fusion framework for continual learning of vision-language models.

projects.name: EnvOpt: Environment Optimization for Self-Evolving Agents
highlights: Designed a traceable behavioral map, target-conditioned context refinement, and iterative environment construction.
Raised the learnable-task rate from 21% to 57%, with approximately 15 percentage points of average improvement over the base model across four agentic tool-use benchmarks.

projects.name: Scaling Active Perception for Multimodal Reasoning
highlights: Unified long-chain reasoning and tool-calling through SFT and RL.
Designed mode-aware process rewards and improved over the original VLM on MathVision, MathVista, HRBench, and V*.
